title: The ACID Properties knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes “The ACID Properties”?
options: It is best handled by removing constraints and skipping error checks.

A transaction groups related data changes into a single reliability boundary. Isolation and locking affect what concurrent sessions can see or change; keep transactions short and design retries so the same business action is not applied twice.
It is a frontend styling feature and does not involve database behavior.
It guarantees correct output regardless of schema, permissions, or release version.
questions.answer_key: A transaction groups related data changes into a single reliability boundary. Isolation and locking affect what concurrent sessions can see or change; keep transactions short and design retries so the same business action is not applied twice.
